title: Capacity-weight sensitivity of the headline and the gate contrast

scope.not_propagated: floor models, the physical target and the second-provider check keep the 2024-09 weights
scope.gate45c_applicability: Gate 45c pins the capacity-weighted cells to phase74 bit for bit and does NOT extend to the re-weighted arms: different weights are different inputs. The 2024-09 arm here is checked against phase85 instead, by Gate 60
scope.time_varying_weights: not computable: AreaPoint carries no time axis and the reference CSV holds two workbook snapshots, so a monthly or quarterly weight series cannot be built. Recorded as a limitation rather than approximated

gate_timing_delta.definition: MAE(headline) - MAE(excluded run), pooled daily; positive means the EXCLUDED run is better, matching phase85's gate_timing_delta
